name: diff
description: Show what changed, as a unified diff. By default the unstaged changes in the working tree; with staged true, what the next commit would record; with ref, the difference from another branch or commit. Read this before writing a commit message or reviewing work.

staged.description: Diff what is staged instead of what is not. This is what the next commit would record.

ref.description: Diff against this branch, tag or commit rather than the index (e.g. "main"). Combines with staged.

path.description: Limit the diff to this path, relative to the workspace root. Must resolve inside it.

summary.description: One line per file with a count of added and removed lines, instead of the diff itself. Ask for this first when the change might be large.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. The output says so when it truncates. Narrow with path or summary rather than raising this.

output_schema.description: A unified diff as git writes it, or with summary true one line per file followed by a totals line. Nothing to diff is the single line "[git/diff] no changes" and still succeeds. A diff longer than max_lines is followed by a "[git/diff] truncated: ..." notice.

exit_codes.0: success (the diff is on stdout, including when it is empty)
exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is the wrong type)
exit_codes.3: not found (the ref does not resolve, or the path does not exist)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the git repository is above the workspace root, or the path leaves it)
exit_codes.5: no repository (the workspace is not a git repository, or git is not installed)
